# Prime Clean

> Women-Owned, California Small Business Certified Commercial & Government Cleaning Contractor based in Richmond, California, serving the San Francisco Bay Area.

## Overview
Prime Clean provides protocol-driven commercial cleaning, office janitorial, medical clinic disinfection, warehouse floor care, and public sector facility maintenance. Headquartered in Richmond, CA, Prime Clean is an independently certified Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and California Small Business (SB) with active SAM.gov registration (NAICS 561720).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Commercial Office Cleaning**: Daily janitorial, workstation sanitization, executive conference detailing, after-hours keycard service.
- **Medical & Healthcare Clinic Disinfection**: EPA-registered hospital disinfectants, terminal cleaning, color-coded microfiber cross-contamination prevention, HEPA filtration.
- **Industrial & Warehouse Floor Care**: Electric ride-on scrubber concrete degreasing, loading dock sanitation, high-bay dust control.
- **Government & Municipal Janitorial**: Certified WOSB and CA SB contractor, prevailing wage compliance, digital audit logs, NAICS 561720, SAM.gov active.
- **Property Management & Multifamily**: Common area cleaning for apartment communities, residential towers, and HOA portfolios.
- **Retail & Showroom Janitorial**: Storefront display glass, high-gloss floor buffing, fitting room hygiene.
- **Educational Facility Cleaning**: Child-safe Green Seal certified chemistry, term break deep resets, district procurement alignment.
- **Financial Institutions & Banking**: Security-vetted, background-checked crew, marble floor care, after-hours security compliance.

## Company & Compliance Information
- **Company Name**: Prime Clean
- **Legal Entity**: Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB)
- **State Certification**: California Small Business (SB) Certified — Cal eProcure Cert. #2041245
- **DIR Registration**: California Department of Industrial Relations No. JS-LR-1001318678 (Active)
- **Federal Registration**: Active on SAM.gov (Unique Entity ID on file)
- **Primary NAICS Codes**:

  - 561210: Facilities Support Services
  - 561740: Carpet and Upholstery Cleaning Services
- **Insurance & Bonding**: Commercial general liability, workers' compensation, performance bonding on request

## Primary Service Areas
- **Contra Costa County**: Richmond (Headquarters), Point Richmond, El Sobrante, San Pablo, El Cerrito, Pinole, Hercules, Walnut Creek, Concord, San Ramon.
- **Alameda County**: Oakland, Berkeley, Alameda, Emeryville, San Leandro, Hayward, Fremont, Pleasanton.
